integrity: Original proof and reproducible finite exact-arithmetic checks. No third-party source documents copied; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Worst-case positive-equilibrium feasibility, not typical random behavior. Earlier feasible witnesses are unstable; no global stability is claimed there. Component bound is at least floor(n/2)+1, not exact maximum. Main source article was inspected but its supplement could not be read, leaving a historical-priority risk. The first dated public communication located is a research seminar on 2026-01-16; journal article publicly released 2026-02-11. No earlier public manuscript release was verified.
title: Arbitrarily many robust feasibility reversals in fully competitive Lotka–Volterra communities
